portable.description: If true, stores all settings in the executable folder (portable mode). Corresponds to -p command-line option.

nosplash.description: If true, disables the splash screen on startup. Corresponds to -s command-line option.

notrayicon.description: If true, disables the tray icon. Corresponds to -t command-line option.

last_script.description: Path to the last opened script file. Typically auto-populated by Actiona.

noexecutionwindow.description: If true, hides the execution window by default. Corresponds to -E command-line option.

noconsolewindow.description: If true, hides the console window by default. Corresponds to -C command-line option.

nocodeqt.description: If true, excludes the Qt library when building standalone executables. Corresponds to -Q command-line option.
